storage.note: These figures count rows, not bytes: no storage integration is connected, so files are tracked without being hosted here.

connectors.unconfiguredDetail: An unconfigured integration is not a fault: nothing has ever been connected to it. Each affected screen states exactly what that prevents.
connectors.mismatched_one: {{count}} integration is declared in production in the configuration but has no address in the server's environment. The declared mode does not by itself connect a system.
connectors.mismatched_other: {{count}} integrations are declared in production in the configuration but have no address in the server's environment. The declared mode does not by itself connect a system.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.emptyDetail: Nobody is currently connected to the platform, aside possibly from your own session if it has just expired server-side.
sessions.lastActivity: Last activity recorded in the log:

ai.loadError: Unable to load the AI configuration.
ai.title: AI configuration
ai.subtitle: Provider, model, quota, agents and prompt templates — saved durably, awaiting a provider to be connected.

banner.none: No language model provider is connected.
banner.connectedNote: This model rephrases the assistant's answers. It never queries the database itself: the search is performed upstream, with the permissions of the person asking, and the cited sources always come from that search — never from text produced by the model. If the call fails, the assistant falls back to the search-only answer.
banner.noneNote: The five agents still answer, by searching the platform's own data with the permissions of the person asking. Setting HF_API_KEY in the server's environment adds rephrasing; it does not switch on the feature, which already works.

form.title: Provider, model and quota
form.monthlyQuotaHint: In requests. Empty = no cap set.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: An agent reads with the permissions of whoever queries it: it can never surface a row the person could not open themselves. Enabling an agent records the intent; agents marked "operational" already answer, by searching the platform's own data, with no language model at all.
agents.promptPlaceholder: Instruction given to the agent. The rule that already applies without a provider: every answer cites its source, or admits it found nothing.

ai.footnote: The settings on this form are saved but do not yet drive the assistant: it reads its configuration from the server's environment (HF_API_KEY, HF_MODEL, HF_BASE_URL), not from this table. The {{count}} agent(s) marked "operational" answer by searching the platform's own data, with the permissions of the person asking{{tail}}
ai.footnoteTailConnected: , then have that answer rephrased by the connected model.
ai.footnoteTailNone: , with no call to a language model.

audit.loadError: Unable to load the audit log.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every connection and every action recorded, with its author, its timestamp and its IP address.
audit.emptyFiltered: No entries match these filters. Widen the period or change the action.
audit.emptyAll: The log is empty: no action has been recorded on this instance yet.
audit.footnote: Filters are applied by the server, across the whole log: filtering an already-loaded page would not answer "show me every denial in March". The server caps a request at 500 rows. The CSV export reproduces exactly the {{count}} row(s) shown above — no more, no less — and the file is generated in your browser, without going through a third-party service.

noExecutor.title: No backup executor is connected.
noExecutor.body: The schedules below are saved and logged, but nothing in this application triggers them: no backup runs, and no restore is possible from this screen. Actual backup today is the database host's responsibility.

history.title: History
history.emptyDetail: No backup process is running: this history is empty because nothing feeds it.

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.subtitle: Request register, and inventory of data held by the platform.

notAutomated.title: Fulfilment is not automated.
notAutomated.body: This register tracks requests and what became of them. Closing a request records that a person did the work elsewhere — no erasure or export is triggered from this screen. Several categories below cannot, in any case, simply be deleted.

form.subject: Data subject
form.notePlaceholder: Origin of the request, documents received, action taken…

dataHeld.title: Data held
dataHeld.subtitle: What the platform retains, and what erasure would actually mean for each category.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: What the platform is connected to, what it is meant to be connected to, and the gap between the two.

mode.productionMeaning: The integration is meant to talk to the real system.
mode.mockMeaning: The integration answers with demo data, deliberately.

env.production: An address is configured in the server's environment.
env.mock: The environment variable is set to "mock".
env.unconfigured: No address is configured in the server's environment.
env.label: Environment:

integrations.confirmProductionSwitch: Switch "{{label}}" to production? No address is configured in the server's environment: the integration will be declared in production without being connected.
integrations.declaredProductionUnreachable: "{{label}}" is declared in production, but the server's environment gives it no address.
integrations.mismatchedWarning_one: {{count}} integration is declared in production with no address in the server's environment.
integrations.mismatchedWarning_other: {{count}} integrations are declared in production with no address in the server's environment.
integrations.mismatchedWarningBody: The mode recorded here is an intention. The actual connection is made through an environment variable at deployment: while it is empty, nothing goes anywhere.
integrations.testFailedFallback: The test could not be run.
integrations.noFieldsYet: This integration has no parameters to enter yet: only its mode can be set here.

whatSwitchDoes.title: What the switch does
whatSwitchDoes.body: It durably records the intended mode for each integration, with an entry in the audit log. That is the intent declared by the administration.

whatSwitchDoesNot.title: What it does not do
whatSwitchDoesNot.body: It does not connect any system: the real address comes from the server's environment, fixed at deployment. No Entra ID tenant, no HR system and no SMTP relay answers on this deployment — the "Test" button says so explicitly rather than showing a reassuring green tick.

organization.title: Org units
organization.subtitle: The organisation's skeleton: divisions, departments, sites and reporting lines that HR will fill in.
organization.confirmArchiveUnit: Archive the unit "{{name}}"? The operation is refused if it still contains units or positions.
organization.confirmMerge: Merge "{{source}}" into "{{target}}"? All attached units, positions and permission scopes will be moved, then the source unit will be archived.
organization.mergeDone: Merge complete: {{units}} unit(s), {{positions}} position(s) and {{scopes}} scope(s) moved.
organization.positionDetached: Position detached: it becomes a root of the org chart.

unitTree.title: Unit tree
unitTree.emptyDetail: Create a first unit to start the structure.

unitDetail.title: Unit detail
unitDetail.emptyDetail: Choose a unit in the tree to edit, archive or merge it into another.
unitDetail.mergeDetail: All attached units, positions and permission scopes are moved to the target unit in a single operation, then "{{name}}" is archived. A merge into a unit attached to it is refused: the branch would become detached from the org chart.

positionChart.title: Position org chart
positionChart.hint: Click a position to reassign it elsewhere. A position with no superior appears as a root.
positionChart.empty: No positions in the org chart. Create one to start the reporting line.

positionDetail.title: Reassigning a position
positionDetail.emptyDetail: Choose a card in the org chart to change its reporting line.
positionDetail.reparentHint: Attaching a position to one of its own subordinates is refused by the server.
positionDetail.reparentNone: None — root of the org chart

organization.footnote: This screen defines the skeleton: units, positions and reporting lines. It does not place anyone — assigning an employee to a position is HR's responsibility, and duplicating it here would give the same action two implementations. Archiving a unit is refused while it still holds active units or positions: the error message states what remains to be moved.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: The role × module × action matrix: what each profile may read, write, validate and delete.
roles.builtinNote: These four profiles are defined in the platform's code, not in the database: every request checks the caller's rights, and querying a table at that point would put a database round trip at the heart of every access check. They are therefore viewable here but only editable through deployment. For a different need, create a custom role.

form.codeHintExisting: An existing role's code cannot be changed.
form.name: Name

roles.customEmptyDetail: The four built-in profiles cover everyday use. Create a custom role for a need none of them describes — an external auditor, for instance, who would read without ever writing.
roles.customFootnote: A custom role is saved durably, with its permissions validated against the platform's catalogue. It is not yet assignable to an account: assignment goes through the four built-in codes, the only ones the authorisation layer recognises. Defining the role is the durable part; wiring it to assignment is a change to that layer, not to this screen.

matrix.notApplicable: This action does not exist for this module

security.loadError: Unable to load the security configuration.
security.title: Security
security.subtitle: What the service actually enforces, and the recorded policy alongside it.

inEffect.title: In effect
inEffect.subtitle: Values read from the configuration validated at start-up. They change at deployment, not from this screen.
inEffect.passwordsDetail: Minimum length: {{length}} characters. Hashed with Argon2id, never stored or logged in any other form.
inEffect.sessionsDetail: {{hours}}-hour duration, extended at most once per {{minutes}}-minute window. Immediate revocation on the next request.
inEffect.encryptionDetail: Exchanges encrypted in transit (TLS). Encryption at rest depends on the host and cannot be verified from the application.
inEffect.replayProtectionDetail: Every mutation requires a CSRF token, and login attempts are rate-limited. Access denials are logged.

recordedPolicy.title: Recorded policy
recordedPolicy.subtitle: This policy is saved and logged, but no component reads it yet: it expresses an intention, not an enforced constraint. The values actually in effect remain those in the block above.
recordedPolicy.neverSavedNote: No policy has been saved yet — the values shown are the default values.
recordedPolicy.mfaRequiredHint: Not implemented: planned via Entra ID rather than reimplemented here.
recordedPolicy.sessionDurationHint: In hours. The duration actually enforced remains that of the deployment.
recordedPolicy.ipAllowlistHint: One entry per line. Recorded only: filtering happens at the network or reverse-proxy level, not in the application.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Settings that can be changed without a deployment. Every change is logged.

orgTree.title: Org chart visibility
orgTree.subtitle: How many levels an employee sees around their own position. Management roles and HR are not limited by these values.
orgTree.depthDownHint: From the position towards the teams.
orgTree.showPeersHint: Positions at the same hierarchical level.

sections.emailNote: Saved only: no SMTP relay is connected, so nothing is actually sent from the platform.

settings.footnote: Other settings — session durations, hashing parameters, database URL — are fixed at deployment and cannot be changed here.

provisioning.loadError: Unable to load the provisioning queue.
provisioning.title: Provisioning queue
provisioning.subtitle: The two sides of the handoff: what HR has requested that IT has not yet created, and what IT has created that nobody has yet assigned.

requestsSide.title: Requests awaiting creation
requestsSide.description: Opened by HR for an upcoming hire. Each one is waiting for an account to be created on the Accounts page.
requestsSide.emptyDetail: HR has no open account requests: nothing is stuck on this side of the handoff.

unplacedSide.title: Accounts created, unassigned
unplacedSide.description: The account exists and the person can log in, but no position is attached to them: no org chart, no onboarding journey, no manager.
unplacedSide.emptyDetail: Every created account is attached to a position.

provisioning.footnote: This page observes the handoff, it does not carry it out: creating an account is done on <0>Accounts</0>, and assigning it to a position is HR's responsibility. No automatic reminder is sent — no scheduler runs in the application, and no SMTP relay is connected. The waiting times above are therefore to be read, not waited on.

users.title: Accounts
users.subtitle: Create, grant, suspend and reset access for the platform's accounts.
users.roleAssignFailedFallback: The account was created, but the role could not be granted. Use "Grant a role" below.
users.importFailed: The import failed: no account was created.
users.selfAssignmentRefused: You cannot grant yourself a role.
users.confirmSuspend: Suspend {{name}}'s account? Their open sessions will be closed immediately.
users.confirmResetAccess: Reset {{name}}'s access? All their sessions will be revoked; their password stays unchanged.
users.resetAccessResult_one: {{count}} session revoked. {{name}} will need to log back in.
users.resetAccessResult_other: {{count}} sessions revoked. {{name}} will need to log back in.

createForm.title: Create an account
createForm.passwordHint: Handed over in person: without an SMTP relay, the platform cannot send it.
createForm.roleHint: Granted at global scope; refine the scope below if needed.

importForm.title: Bulk import
importForm.description: One line per account, semicolon-separated: e-mail ; display name ; phone ; role. Phone and role are optional. The import is atomic: if a single line is rejected, no account is created.
importForm.placeholder:
amina.belkacem@soficlef.dz ; Amina Belkacem ; 0550 00 00 00 ; MANAGER
karim.saidi@soficlef.dz ; Karim Saïdi ; ; EMPLOYEE
importForm.sharedPasswordHint: The same for the whole batch; everyone will have to change it. No notification is sent.

users.emptyDetail: Adjust the search or the status filter.

entraSync.title: Entra ID synchronisation
entraSync.detail: No Entra ID directory is connected to this deployment: there is no tenant to import accounts from. A "Synchronise" button could here only do nothing, or invent people.

entraLink.title: Link an Entra identity
entraLink.detail: Same reason. Passwords are managed by the platform and verified with Argon2; single sign-on will arrive with the integration, visible on the Integrations page.

users.footnote: "Reset access" revokes all of the account's open sessions and forces a fresh login. No new password is generated: without an SMTP relay, the platform would have no way to send it, and displaying it here would mean writing a live credential into a browser.
